verdict:
REJECT — no position, and the kill is CAPITAL ALLOCATION, not weather (blue 8/10, re-based off red). Blue overturned red's weather-and-street case as weaker than argued: the FY27 estimate is already sub-FY25, deferred revenue is FLAT, and red's own operating-cash-flow falsification test had already been passed. What survives is harder to argue with — Vail is returning 324% OF FREE CASH FLOW to shareholders while NET DEBT RISES 18.5% IN A YEAR, on an asset whose earnings power is weather-conditional and whose resort franchise nobody has marked. At 11.2x TROUGH EBITDA with no differentiated FY27 number, we have neither a price nor an edge — which is the §DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE kill in its proper form.

THE SNOWPACK EVIDENCE STANDS BUT DID NOT DECIDE IT. The connector built for this court found the season customers just experienced ran at ~55% OF MEDIAN peak snow-water-equivalent (Vail Mountain 48%, Fremont Pass 46%, Copper 54%, Tahoe 73%, 11 water years each). That is real and it is the memory the current pass cycle is being sold into — but blue is right that Vail's model insulates the SOLD year, so a bad winter transmits through the NEXT cycle and ancillary spend rather than through the pass line. Deferred revenue being FLAT is the observation that keeps this a second-order concern rather than the thesis.

CONNECTOR FAILURE, DISCLOSED: the bench dispatched resort_snowpack FIVE TIMES and got ZERO observations — 'no resort/station map for VAIL MOUNTAIN; known: [MTN]'. It resolved only on ticker while benches dispatch on resort NAMES. The bench's own words: 'infra failure wearing the costume of an analytic absence — the reversion base rate is the single missing number in this court.' FIXED THIS SESSION (name/operator/resort resolution added, verified on 'VAIL MOUNTAIN', 'Vail Resorts' and 'MTN'), but the court ran WITHOUT it and the verdict should be read knowing that the snow-reversion base rate was never available to either bench.
reopen_gates: NONE. Re-court needs ALL THREE: (i) the 9/28 print with pass UNITS flat-to-up through late September; (ii) a dividend reset to <=$4.50 (frees ~$155M/yr to deleveraging — a POSITIVE catalyst); (iii) a marked private-market comp for the resort portfolio. Entry zone if reached: EV/EBITDA <8x on NORMAL snow => $105-115.
adjudicator_note: Both courts disclosed connector defects that were reproduced and FIXED this session; MTN ran WITHOUT its snowpack read (5 dispatches, 0 observations) and the verdict should be read accordingly.
